mapper.sql: id, user_id, gender, height, weight, bust, waist, hip, city, style_pref, avatar_image_id, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM body_profile WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO body_profile (user_id, gender, height, weight, bust, waist, hip, city, style_pref, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{gender}, #{height}, #{weight}, #{bust}, #{waist}, #{hip}, #{city}, #{stylePref}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE body_profile SET gender = #{gender}, height = #{height}, weight = #{weight}, bust = #{bust}, waist = #{waist}, hip = #{hip}, city = #{city}, style_pref = #{stylePref}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE body_profile SET avatar_image_id = #{avatarImageId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
